Symptoms included Ollama swapping, API timeouts above 90 seconds, and SignalR clients showing stuck batch jobs. Proposed mitigation includes serializing LLM steps, lowering MaxDegreeOfParallelism for classification during import batches, and adding pause/continue controls so engineers can free memory for RAG demos mid-run. Additional notes: include overdue markers, mention PostgreSQL vacuum after bulk import, and warn that Force=true on summarize bypasses cache and may saturate the local model.
